basic_info.description: Step into timeless character and comfort with this well maintained 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath home, built in 1912. Inside, you'll find hardwood floors, original stained glass, and abundant natural light. The inviting living room flows into a formal dining room with fireplace. An updated kitchen offers an island with bonus sink, gas range, Subzero fridge and abundant cabinetry. Step outside to discover your garden retreat with lush landscaping and a quiet sitting area. Both bedrooms are generously sized, with the primary bedroom boasting a wood-burning fireplace. The second bedroom enjoys period detail windows and a generous window seat. A full bath with separate tub and shower and an additional half bath adds flexibility and function. A bonus room with built-in cabinets and a cozy window seat is an ideal work-from-home environment.  On the top level is a spacious, flexible space with windows framing stunning views. A charming stained-glass door leads to an expansive deck with sparkling downtown views.  Additional features include garage parking, ample storage, washer dryer hookups and effortless access to Cole Valley shops and restaurants, Golden Gate Park and transportation. This unique home offers the exceptional combination of historical charm and modern living in a coveted location.
